cases.name: Amie Nicole Harwick
cases.about: "Harwick earned her master’s degree from Pepperdine University in clinical psychology with an emphasis on marriage and family therapy. She was also a former Playboy model and the author of The New Sex Bible for Women."  https://www.yahoo.com/entertainment/therapist-amie-harwick-ex-fiancee-drew-carey-murdered-172414148.html
cases.narrative:
Strangulation and thrown from 3rd-floor balcony. The autopsy report details Harwick "sustained severe injuries of her brain, liver, and pelvis in an apparent fall from a height. Injuries of her neck, particularly strap muscle hemorrhage, are consistent with manual strangulation".
